method: macOS sample, duration 10 seconds, interval 1 ms, c3-hello run extended to 300 emulated seconds to cover sampling. Native release binaries supplied for the quiet comparison. Sampling diagnoses work only; timings use separate unprofiled 30-second runs.
privacy: Retained only aggregate simulator function sample counts and raw capture hashes. Omitted process/thread IDs, addresses, paths, loaded-image lists and machine/session metadata. No raw profile is committed.

uart_frame.method: otool -tvV, generated esp32c3 SocBus Bus::tick prologue
uart_frame.change: An out-of-line RX delivery loop restores the idle tick frame size. Board capability checks share one cached active-board branch.
